race.title: Racing Again On The 26th November Handicap Hurdle (0-100)
race.verdict: LICEO has knocked firmly at the door since returning from a short break, again finding only one too good over C&D last week and there appears no reason why he won't make a bold bid again from an unchanged mark. Max Meridius shaped well when a place behind the selection that day and can lay down a serious challenge if consenting to race more efficiently, whilst Phoenix Arizona is another worth a look operating from a lower hurdles mark. LICEO (FR) MAX MERIDIUS (IRE) PHOENIX ARIZONA (IRE)
